question: Hōki-san, what kind of ability do you have? Please tell me!! H: The ability of "POO POO NO MI"! People call me Pooh Taro because I faint with farts...
answer: Yes! Thank you for your hard work, Hōki-san~ It's time!! Are you saying something useless like "Poo Poo no Mi"! I can't stand being fainted by farts... ugh!! Grass... Patter...!!! H: Ah. Odacchi!! Ikan has no pulse. Well then, everyone, disband!! Let's go home! O: Don't leave me alone!! *
name: YawD
